name: Easy Wishlist
author: themewant

sections.description:
Easy Wishlist allows users to save products as wishlists on your website. They can access these wishlisted products via a dedicated page or widget.

The plugin is ideal for users who want to save products & add to cart them later without needing to search again.

Features

  • Users can wishlist any product with a single click.
  • Wishlist management with add/remove wishlist functionality.
  • Display wishlisted products in a widget or on a custom page.
  • Simple shortcode to show the wishlist counter.
  • Compatible with any theme.
  • Fully responsive and user-friendly.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/easy-wishlist directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Place the [eswislst_product_list] shortcode where you want to display the wishlisted products.

Live Demo
sections.faq:
How do users wishlist a post?

Users will see a “Wishlist” button on each product which they can click to add or remove a wishlist.

Can wishlists be displayed on a custom page?

Yes, you can use the [eswislst_product_list] shortcode or a widget to display wishlisted products on any page.
